Contract ManageBookCopyCRUDService::addBookCopy(callNo: String,barcode: String,location: String): Boolean {
	definition:
		book: Book = Book.allInstance()->any(b|b.CallNo = callNo),
		newCopy: BookCopy = BookCopy.oclIsNew()
	precondition:
		Book.allInstance()->includes(book) and
		BookCopy.allInstance()->excludes(newCopy)
	postcondition:
		BookCopy.allInstance()->includes(newCopy) and
		book.Copys->includes(newCopy) and
		newCopy.BookBelongs = book and
